description: Search the public record of what the NIH pays for: every grant, contract and intramural project since the 1980s, with the money, the researchers, the institutions and the papers that came out of it. Find the projects working on a topic, read one in full including its abstract, see who the best-funded researchers in a field are, total up the spending by year, institute, university or state, or start from a paper and find the grants behind it. Awards from the VA, FDA, AHRQ and parts of the CDC are covered too. No account or API key is required.
